 Order
This criminal original petition has been filed to quash the proceedings in C.C.No.1 of 2016 pending on the file of the learned Judicial Magistrate, Fast Track Court, Coonoor.

2. Based on the complaint given by the second respondent, an FIR came to be registered in Crime No.8 of 2012 against the two accused persons for offence under Sections 498A and 406 of IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The petitioner was arrayed as A2 in the FIR.

The investigation was completed and the final report was filed before the learned Judicial Magistrate,
Fast Track Court, Coonoor.
The case was split up and the trial was conducted only as against A1 in C.C.No.1 of 2019.

3. There was a settlement between the parties and the same was taken into consideration by the trial Court while passing judgement dated 28.08.2019 and the criminal proceedings as against A1 was brought to an end and A1 was acquitted from all the charges.
4 . T h e p e t i t i o n e r ( A 2 ) a p p r o a c h e d t h i s C o u r t a n d f i l e d C r l . O . P . N o .
2 2 8 2 3 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis of 2021 seeking to quash the proceedings, which was split up and pending against the petitioner in C.C.No.1 of 2016
. This Court dismissed the petition by an order dated 29.07.2022 since a non-bailable warrant was pending against the petitioner.
5. The petitioner filed a petition under Section 70(2) of CrPC seeking to re-call the warrant and the warrant was re-called by the learned Judicial Magistrate, Fast Track Court, Coonoor.
Thereafter, the present petition has been filed seeking to quash the proceedings.

6. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the respondent and also perused the materials available on record.
7.
It is seen from the records that the matter has already been compromised between the second respondent and her husband (A1).
The proceedings as against A1 was also brought to an end by the judgement made in C.C.No.1 of 2019 dated 28.08.2019.
It is also seen that the Domestic Violence proceedings that was initiated also came to an end by order dated 08.08.2019 by the learned Judicial Magistrate, Fast Track Court, Coonoor.

Hence, the continuation of proceedings against the petitioner will only lead to abuse of https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis process of law, which requires interference of this Court exercising its jurisdiction under Section 482 of CrPC.
8.

In the result, the proceedings in CC.No.1 of 2016 on the file of the learned Judicial Magistrate,
Fast Track Court, Coonoor is quashed.
Accordingly, this criminal original petition is allowed.
Consequently, the connected miscellaneous petitions are also closed.
